privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Guess the Crowd works without accounts, ads or tracking. Here is exactly what we store.
sections: On your device: a random player ID, your settings, your language and your game history (for stats). This is stored in your browser’s local storage, not in cookies. Clearing your browser data removes it.
On our server: your yes/no answer to each question and your guesses, linked only to the random player ID. We do not know who you are.

For abuse protection we keep a salted, one-way hash of your IP address for at most two days. The salt changes every day, so hashes from different days cannot be linked. We never store your raw IP address.
If you suggest a question, we store its text, its language and the nickname you entered (if any).

We use no tracking cookies, no advertising and no third-party analytics that track individuals. If voting is abused we may show a Cloudflare Turnstile check, which processes data under Cloudflare’s privacy policy.
Results are only ever published as totals and percentages.
Questions or deletion requests: contact us at {email}. Because we don’t know who you are, include your player ID (shown below) so we can find your data.
